checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Dark blue-black sky, dark street, lit lamps.

must.item: Street and shop architecture retain shapes/positions
must.why: Layout matches closely; minor sign text/details changed.

must.item: Pedestrian on right same pose and blue jacket
must.why: Man in same position and walking pose; jacket is darker navy but still blue.
Warm shop glow, lamp glows, reflections on road are plausible.

must.item: Wide composition preserved, no new subjects/objects
must.why: A car with headlights and taillights is added/changed in the middle of the road, and extra cars further back; a new person-like figure near the right sign. The request did ask for car lights, though.

faults.what: A car moved/added mid-road, slightly different from the original parked car at the curb
Shop sign text and window contents regenerated, with slight differences
Man's jacket is dark and less clearly blue

summary: A convincing night version of the same street with the man kept in place; the only real issue is a car that was changed or moved into the road, plus some small detail drift.
